authority: Octon Mini source for project-local artifact registries; transfers structure only.

artifact_types.purpose: Route readers to authoritative layers without restating mutable content.
questions: Where do I start?
Which profile and information layers apply?
Where is current work summarized?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Navigation only; it links authoritative sources and never owns their mutable facts.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create first as the dossier entry point.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit. It may share a file with HOF-0001 only for truly single-session work if authority and state remain visibly separate.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Define dossier precedence, information roles, conflict handling, and the non-authorizing boundary.
questions: Which source governs each concern?
How are conflicts handled?
What cannot grant permission?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Authoritative only for interpreting dossier information; operating permission remains outside the dossier.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create before project-specific dossier content is adopted.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit as a concern; Minimal may combine it with DOS-0003 under distinct headings.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Name the single source owner and edit direction for every mutable concern.
questions: Where is each definition maintained?
Which view is generated?
How does profile choice change representation ownership?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Authoritative for concern-to-source routing; it does not duplicate the routed content.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create with the first canonical and observed-state artifacts.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit as a concern; Minimal may combine it with DOS-0002 under distinct headings.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Provide a normalized, machine-readable point-in-time view of the project-local artifact registry.
questions: Which type and representation records were cataloged?
From which registry generation was this view produced?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Generated non-authoritative mirror of DOS-0010; never edited independently.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Generate after registry initialization and after every registry change.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit from a generated dossier; consumers that can read DOS-0010 directly may ignore this view but must not edit it.
representative_evidence: Recommended: portable normalized catalog inferred from both reference manifests

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Record a point-in-time managed-file inventory and, when triggered, byte checksums.
questions: Which bytes and paths were checked?
What was excluded?
Are related integrity outputs from one refresh?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Generated evidence only; proves scoped byte identity, not authority, correctness, approval, or readiness.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Generate at scaffold time and refresh after managed changes; checksums are High-Assurance or risk-triggered.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: The manifest is Core. Checksums may be omitted unless audit, release, immutable-baseline, or High-Assurance triggers apply.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Identify the dossier contract version, adoption state, effective date, and change basis.
questions: Which dossier version is current?
Was it merely generated or project-adopted?
What migration applies?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Project-maintained source for dossier version and adoption state.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create at initialization; mark generated baseline as unadopted.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit; it may be presented with the supersession ledger only if the machine-readable lifecycle record remains available.
representative_evidence: Inferred: COE records point-in-time creation and generated integrity but has no direct dossier-version equivalent

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Preserve explicit artifact replacements, effective dates, reasons, migrations, and retained history.
questions: What is no longer current?
What replaced it?
Where is history retained?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Authoritative project-local lifecycle record; changes append or correct through an explicit successor.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create empty at initialization; add a record before a superseded artifact is treated as noncurrent.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit the empty ledger; it may remain empty until the first supersession.
representative_evidence: Recommended: COE has no direct dossier supersession ledger equivalent

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Provide per-path information-state and authority classification derived from the registry.
questions: Which representation owns this path?
What information role and source direction apply?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Generated non-authoritative mirror; DOS-0010 owns representation metadata.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Generate alongside the artifact catalog directly from the artifact registry.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit from an agent-operable generated dossier; non-filesystem adaptations must provide an equivalent locator classification.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Own project-local artifact types, physical representations, applicability decisions, review state, and source direction.
questions: Which artifact types apply?
Which physical representations are active?
Who owns and reviews each one?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Authoritative project-local metadata source seeded by generation and thereafter maintained explicitly; generated views never replace it.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Seed during scaffold generation before derived catalog and path-authority outputs.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit. It is the edit source; DOS-0004 and DOS-0008 must be regenerated from it.
representative_evidence: Recommended: closes the editable-registry and derived-catalog gap observed across both references

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Define project identity, problem, intended outcomes, boundaries, audiences, ownership, and success.
questions: What is this project?
What is explicitly out of scope?
What outcomes and measures define success?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Canonical target definition; proposed or unknown content stays labeled.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create during project framing before detailed requirements.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit; small projects may combine it with REQ-0001 and ARC-0001 under separate sections.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Own requirement wording, basis, status, owner, validation method, and traceability.
questions: What must be true?
Why is it required?
How will it be verified and what currently satisfies it?
recommended_formats: JSON for Standard and High-Assurance record stores
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Minimal owns records in Markdown; Standard and High-Assurance own individual records in JSON while Markdown owns vocabulary and explanation.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create before conformance assessment and implementation planning.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit; prose may share DEF-0001 in Minimal, but requirement IDs and record ownership remain explicit.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Describe intended actors, components or workstreams, boundaries, flows, interfaces, states, and invariants.
questions: How should the intended system or outcome fit together?
Where are boundaries and failure modes?
Which requirements does each part support?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Canonical intended structure; diagrams generated from another source are labeled derived.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create before detailed execution or implementation.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit the concern; non-software projects use outcome, operating, service, or workstream terminology.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Inventory material decision questions, separate recommendations and selections from authority, review credible options, and preserve accepted durable choices and successors.
questions: Which material choices remain unresolved or tracked?
What is recommended versus selected?
Under which authority and scope?
What did it replace and how is it validated?
recommended_formats: Markdown durable records governed by the harness lifecycle
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: The harness decision-governance register owns question, recommendation, selection, review, and closure tracking. Status-dependent DEC-#### records alone own durable accepted authority; an accepted register entry and its resolving DEC record link each other explicitly; dossier and Markdown review views only link or project them.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create when a durable choice is proposed; acceptance requires valid project authority.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: The register and durable store are Core; empty stores are valid and generation must not fabricate a question, recommendation, owner selection, accepted decision, review result, or readiness claim.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.recommended_name: Constraints, quality gates, and readiness criteria
artifact_types.purpose: Define constraints and objective evidence conditions for progression without recording approval itself.
questions: Which gates apply?
Who may decide them?
What exact evidence, expiry, and exception rules apply?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Criteria are canonical; generated proposed gates remain unadopted until project authority accepts them. Approval evidence is separate.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create before any gated work or readiness claim.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit the concern; Minimal may combine prose with requirements, but machine gate records remain separate when present.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Record dated, evidence-backed present reality independently of intended state and plans.
questions: What exists, is absent, is unknown, or differs by environment?
What exact subject and method were inspected?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Authoritative only for the stated subject, scope, environment, method, and observation time.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create after direct initial inspection, not from scaffold generation.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit; before inspection, retain an explicit not_assessed state rather than a false dated baseline.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Compare current evidence with canonical requirements using controlled findings.
questions: What conforms, differs, is absent, or remains unassessed?
Which evidence and requirement support each classification?
recommended_formats: JSON for Standard and High-Assurance finding records
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Minimal may own findings in Markdown; Standard and High-Assurance own finding records in JSON while Markdown owns method and summary.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create after the first current-state baseline.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit; an empty or not_assessed register is valid before evidence exists.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Define future work as a hard-dependency graph with gates, structured blockers, ownership, reciprocal execution-task links, rollback, and closure evidence.
questions: What remains?
Which work is dependency-ready now?
What proves completion and what stops or rolls back the work?
recommended_formats: JSON for Standard and High-Assurance plan-item records
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Minimal may own plan items in Markdown; Standard and High-Assurance own plan-item records in JSON while Markdown owns method and summary.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create after target/current comparison identifies real work.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit the planning entry point; an empty plan is valid and generation must not fabricate accepted work.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Own risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and open questions with review and resolution conditions.
questions: What is uncertain, blocking, accepted, expired, or unresolved?
Who owns the next review or resolution?
recommended_formats: JSON for Standard and High-Assurance records
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Minimal may own items in Markdown; Standard and High-Assurance own item records in JSON while Markdown owns vocabulary and summary.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create during discovery before silent assumptions accumulate.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit; an empty register is valid. Categories may share one store when IDs and vocabularies remain explicit.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Identify sources, versions, retrieval or observation dates, rights, sensitivity, freshness, and limitations.
questions: Where did a consequential claim come from?
May it still be relied upon and used for this purpose?
recommended_formats: JSON for Standard and High-Assurance source records
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Minimal may own source records in Markdown; Standard and High-Assurance own records in JSON while Markdown owns method and summary.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create before a consequential source is relied upon.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit; private or sensitive locators may be represented by safe references rather than exposed values.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Define reproducible validation and index bounded evidence without converting a check result into approval.
questions: What was checked?
On which exact subject and environment?
What result, limitations, and freshness rule apply?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Validation procedure is maintained; executed evidence is immutable and scoped. Standard and High-Assurance index evidence metadata in JSON.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Define methods with requirements; create evidence only after observation or execution.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit the validation entry point; the evidence index may be empty before checks run.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Provide a bounded current view, exact revision, blockers, evidence pointers, and next safe action.
questions: What is active and blocked?
What evidence is fresh?
What should the next maintainer inspect or do first?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Derived navigation only; links to mutable owners and never becomes a second status store.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create before the first multi-session handoff.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Never omit for multi-session work; a truly single-session project may combine it with DOS-0001 while preserving separate state labels.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.purpose: Track conversion of a generated structure into an adopted project dossier and harness without implying readiness.
questions: Which adoption steps are complete?
Which project facts, owners, checks, and extensions remain unresolved?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Tracking aid only; checked boxes do not create authority or substantive evidence.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Seed during generation and maintain through initial adoption or upgrade.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: May be archived after adoption is demonstrably complete; keep its outcome or successor in history when assurance requires.

applicability.rationale: Core artifact type for the selected profile.

artifact_types.recommended_name: Domain models, workflows, interfaces, and schemas
artifact_types.purpose: Specify specialist entities, states, interfaces, handoffs, and controlled vocabularies beyond the core outcome model.
questions: Which domain concepts and transitions require precise contracts?
Where are interface and ownership boundaries?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Each model declares its edit source; generated diagrams or mirrors point to that source.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create when domain complexity exceeds the core architecture or outcome model.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Omit when ARC-0001 answers all domain questions without ambiguity.

applicability.rationale: Generation does not establish trigger applicability.

artifact_types.recommended_name: Trust, security, privacy, legal, and compliance model
artifact_types.purpose: Define applicable trust boundaries, threats, controls, obligations, specialist gates, and residual risks.
questions: What sensitive or regulated interests exist?
Which qualified reviews and controls are required?
What remains unresolved?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Canonical specialist criteria and models; no generated template establishes a qualified conclusion.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create before handling sensitive data, credentials, regulated activity, public claims, money, or external effects.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Omit only after triggers are explicitly assessed as not applicable; related low-risk criteria may be combined with GOV-0001.

applicability.rationale: Generation does not establish trigger applicability.

artifact_types.recommended_name: Operations, release, incident, and recovery runbooks
artifact_types.purpose: Provide executable, exercised procedures for recurring operations and failure recovery.
questions: How is the outcome operated, released, rolled back, restored, or retired?
What evidence proves the procedure works?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Project-maintained procedures; execution evidence is separate and dated.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create before deployment, publication, ongoing service, operator handoff, or irreversible effect.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Omit before operations exist; combine small related procedures only when owners, triggers, and evidence remain clear.

applicability.rationale: Generation does not establish trigger applicability.

artifact_types.purpose: Record mutable external facts, source comparison, contradictions, verdicts, and reverification deadlines.
questions: Which external facts affect decisions?
When and how were they verified?
When do they expire?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Research records own bounded findings; source identity and freshness remain in provenance.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create before a mutable external fact drives a consequential choice.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Omit when no consequential mutable external fact is used; small research notes may live with provenance if conclusions and expiry remain explicit.

applicability.rationale: Generation does not establish trigger applicability.

artifact_types.purpose: Control adoption, replacement, split, merge, and version migration without silently overwriting authority or history.
questions: What changes and what remains authoritative?
How is compatibility, rollback, and acceptance demonstrated?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Project-maintained migration intent and crosswalk; execution evidence and accepted decisions remain separate.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create before changing an established project, dossier, harness, architecture, or major version.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Omit for an empty new project with no predecessor.
representative_evidence: Recommended: no direct COE transition package equivalent

applicability.rationale: Generation does not establish trigger applicability.

artifact_types.purpose: Retain noncurrent evidence or baselines for audit, recovery, provenance, or regulated retention.
questions: What historical snapshot is retained?
Why and for how long?
Which current successor replaces it?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Explicitly noncurrent immutable history; current authority always routes to a successor.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create when a retained baseline or superseded evidence set is required.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Omit when version control and ordinary supersession records fully satisfy retention and recovery needs.
representative_evidence: Recommended: COE generated integrity is current evidence, not a historical-baseline equivalent

applicability.rationale: Generation does not establish trigger applicability.

artifact_types.recommended_name: Data classification, lifecycle, and retention model
artifact_types.purpose: Classify sensitive, personal, confidential, licensed, regulated, or production data across collection, flow, retention, and deletion.
questions: What data exists and where does it flow?
How is it classified, retained, minimized, and deleted?
Who owns each decision?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Canonical project-specific classification and lifecycle model; no real data values belong in the dossier.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create before collecting or importing triggered data classes.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Omit only after data triggers are assessed as not applicable; a small low-risk inventory may combine with SEC-0001.

applicability.rationale: Generation does not establish trigger applicability.

artifact_types.recommended_name: Supply-chain, dependency, vendor, and license inventory
artifact_types.purpose: Track external code, models, content, datasets, packages, services, vendors, versions, licenses, provenance, and update risk.
questions: Which external inputs are relied upon?
Under what version, license, rights, and trust assumptions?
How are updates and vulnerabilities handled?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Machine inventory should be generated from lockfiles or declared sources where possible; judgments and exceptions remain project-maintained.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create before relying on external code, content, models, data, packages, or vendors.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Omit only when the project has no external supply-chain input; very small inventories may combine with provenance.

applicability.rationale: Generation does not establish trigger applicability.

artifact_types.purpose: Make repeated subjective, model-assisted, or high-impact quality review reproducible.
questions: What quality dimensions and thresholds apply?
Which fixtures, raters, and limitations make evaluation repeatable?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Versioned rubric and fixtures own evaluation semantics; generated scores are point-in-time evidence.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create when quality judgments recur or material consequences justify calibrated evaluation.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Omit when ordinary objective validation is sufficient; combine with VAL-0001 only if rubric versioning and fixtures remain explicit.
representative_evidence: Recommended: no direct COE evaluation-suite equivalent

applicability.rationale: Generation does not establish trigger applicability.

artifact_types.purpose: Package selectively loaded, size-bounded, versioned context for a declared purpose and consumer without duplicating authority or permission.
questions: What exact purpose, consumer, task class, and scope apply?
Which exact source versions and authority states does it reference?
When does it expire, require revalidation, become invalid or revoked, and require deletion?
Which sensitivity and use restrictions apply, what is excluded, and what does possession of the pack not prove?
artifact_types.source_of_truth_expectations: Derived or curated navigation only; packs may narrow context but never replace sources or expand authority.
artifact_types.creation_timing: Create when the dossier is too large for reliable routine loading or specialist routing recurs.
artifact_types.omission_or_combination: Omit when the dossier index and handoff already provide sufficient bounded context. Generation supplies only the High-Assurance optional schema and an unassessed entry point; it never creates a manifest or adopts CTX-0001.
representative_evidence: Inferred: COE compact handoff demonstrates bounded routing without separate packs

applicability.rationale: Generation does not establish trigger applicability.
